source: Euler-Bernoulli cantilever under its own weight: tip deflection = q*L^4/(8*E*I) with q = density*g*w*h and I = w*h^3/12, support reaction = q*L (L = 1000 mm, h = 20 mm, w = 20 mm, E = 210000 MPa, density = 7.85e-09 t/mm^3, g = 9810 mm/s^2 acting in -y); the printed total force of FIXED also holds the self-weight that the FIXED nodes carry themselves (CalculiX manual section 7.98), hence the 1 % tolerance on the reaction
